# Trovina: full details for language models

Last updated: 2026-10-05
Website: https://trovina.io

## Summary

Trovina is a software and digital product studio. A small senior team of designers and engineers designs, builds and supports websites, web applications, mobile apps and AI automation for startups and growing businesses. Every project has a written scope and a fixed price agreed before work begins, weekly working demos, and included support after launch. Clients own 100% of the code, designs and accounts.

Industries served and typical builds:
- Real estate: property listing websites, tenant and rent portals, estate and facility management.
- Schools and institutions: school management systems, parent and student portals, online fees and e-learning.
- E-commerce and supermarkets: online stores and delivery, POS and inventory, loyalty and WhatsApp ordering.
- Healthcare: hospital ERP, appointment booking, pharmacy and lab systems.
- Logistics and transport: fleet tracking, dispatch and delivery apps, waybill and trip records.
- Fintech and cooperatives: savings and loan apps, member portals, payments and wallets.
- Oil, gas and energy: asset and maintenance tracking, HSE incident reporting, field team apps.
- Hospitality: hotel booking websites, restaurant ordering, event and ticketing.

## Pricing (starting points; final price is a fixed quote after a scoping call)

Local clients are invoiced in Naira (NGN); international clients in US dollars (USD).

| Plan | From (NGN) | From (USD) | Typical timeline | Includes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Website | ₦450,000 | $750 | 2–3 weeks | Up to 8 custom pages, mobile-first, CMS, on-page SEO and Google Business setup, forms, WhatsApp and analytics, 30 days support |
| Web app | ₦1,800,000 | $2,800 | 6–10 weeks | Everything in Website plus user accounts, admin dashboard, payments (Paystack, Flutterwave or Stripe), integrations, weekly demos, 60 days support |
| Product | ₦4,500,000 | $7,500 | 10–16 weeks | Everything in Web app plus iOS and Android app, AI automation, cloud setup and monitoring, security review, 90 days support |
| Monthly care plan | ₦150,000 / month | $250 / month | Ongoing | Updates, maintenance, SEO and design support |

Starting prices by service:
- Websites & web apps: from ₦450,000 / $750 per project
- Mobile apps: from ₦2,500,000 / $3,500 per project
- AI automation: from ₦600,000 / $900 per project
- Cloud & DevOps: from ₦350,000 / $600 per project
- SEO & growth: from ₦150,000 / $250 per month
- Branding & identity: from ₦250,000 / $400 per project
- Graphics & creative: from ₦60,000 / $100 per design pack
- Video & motion: from ₦40,000 / $80 per video

Payment terms: usually a 50% deposit to start, with the balance split across agreed milestones.

## Services

### Websites & web apps
Fast, search-friendly websites and web applications built with React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS and Laravel: company websites, online stores, booking platforms, customer portals and SaaS products.
https://trovina.io/services/web-app-website-development

### Mobile apps
iOS and Android apps built in Flutter, React Native, Swift or Kotlin, from MVPs to production apps.
https://trovina.io/services/mobile-app-development

### AI automation
WhatsApp assistants, AI receptionists, lead capture and follow-up, billing automation and CRM-connected workflows using OpenAI, LangChain, n8n, Make and Zapier. Most systems are deployed in 2–4 weeks.
https://trovina.io/services/ai-automation-workflow-systems

### Cloud & DevOps
Hosting and infrastructure on AWS, Google Cloud and Azure with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, backups and cost management.
https://trovina.io/services/cloud-infrastructure-devops

### SEO & growth
Technical SEO, keyword research, content systems and conversion optimisation to grow organic enquiries.
https://trovina.io/services/seo-growth-optimization

### Branding & identity
Logos, colour palettes, typography, brand guidelines and visual assets.
https://trovina.io/services/branding-visual-identity

### Graphics & creative
Social media, advertising and marketing design.
https://trovina.io/services/graphics-creative-design

### Video & motion
Video editing, motion graphics and colour grading for reels, ads, YouTube and product videos.
https://trovina.io/services/video-editing-motion-content

## Recent work

- Hospital ERP (SaaS): cloud hospital management platform with patient records, appointments, billing and HMO claims, pharmacy, laboratory, inventory and reports. Multi-tenant, with role-based access for clinical and admin staff.
- HR management system (white label): HR platform resold by partners under their own brand and domain. Employee records, leave and attendance, payroll with statutory deductions, appraisals and an employee self-service portal.
- Transport and fleet tracking system (web admin + mobile app): live GPS tracking, trip history, driver assignment, fuel and maintenance logs, and speeding and idling alerts. Web admin for dispatchers; iOS and Android app for drivers.

## How a project runs

1. Discovery: a short call and workshop to understand the business, customers and goals.
2. Scope & quote: a written scope, timeline and fixed price; nothing starts until it is approved.
3. Design: wireframes and clickable designs reviewed before code is written.
4. Build: weekly sprints with a working demo every Friday.
5. Launch: testing, speed and security checks, analytics and go-live.
6. Support: included support after launch, then optional monthly care.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: How much does a website or app cost?
A: Business websites start from ₦450,000 (US$750), web apps and online stores from ₦1,800,000 (US$2,800), and full web and mobile products from ₦4,500,000 (US$7,500). Trovina sends a fixed quote after a short call.

Q: How long does a project take?
A: Websites usually launch in 2–3 weeks, web apps in 6–10 weeks, and full web and mobile products in 10–16 weeks.

Q: How do payments work?
A: Usually a 50% deposit, with the rest split across milestones. Naira invoices for local clients, US dollars for international clients.

Q: Where is the team based?
A: The studio is in Port Harcourt, Nigeria, and works with clients remotely worldwide.

Q: Who owns the code and designs?
A: The client owns all source code, designs and assets.

Q: Can Trovina take over an existing website or app?
A: Yes. Audits, fixes, modernisation and partial rebuilds of existing products.
